newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DMG ups Chesapeake Energy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DMG ups Chesapeake Energy.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Paul Buongiorno said he raised Chesapeake Energy to buy from hold.
-- He maintained his previous target price of $62 and his earnings estimates of $2.06 for the fiscal 1997 year, $2.42 per share for fiscal 1998 and $2.57 for fiscal 1999.

-- The analyst said Chesapeake's stock price assumes a 35 percent Louisiana drilling success rate, well below Buongiorno's own assumption of a 50 percent rate and the 80 percent drilling success rate realized to date.
-- He added that the 50 percent success rate could prove conservative. The price target also takes into account Chesapeake's proven reserve base and acreage postion, he said.
-- Shares were trading up 2 at 53-3/4 in midday exchange trade.
